verdict.rationale: Otter's marketing claims 'speaker recognition' alongside live transcription, and its pricing lists 'taggable speakers'. Together these suggest diarization plus the ability to attach real names to speakers. Both are one-line claims with no detail on whether names are matched automatically or tagged by hand, and no evidence on accuracy. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic name matching (e.g., from calendar invitees or voice profiles), detail on how diarization works and how accurate it is, and independent or hands-on confirmation that words land on the right named speaker.
